[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]REVIEW OLD WORDS[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/Review.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Review words with spaced repetition[/b][/p][h2][b]THIS IS NOT A TEST...[/b][/h2][p][b]REVEAL A RANDOM LETTER[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/RandomLetter.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]REVEAL A CHOSEN LETTER[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/RevealLetter.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]REVEAL A RANDOM WORD[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/RandomWord.gif"][/img][/p][p] [b]Never get stuck...

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1/M2)
  • Memory: 2000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel UHD Graphics 600 or Apple M1 GPU)
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard audio

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2nd Gen) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent)
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard audio
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Learn languages by solving crosswords. Solve crosswords → encounter new words → review with spaced repetition → repeat → learn.
supported_languages:
English*, French*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Bulgarian*, Romanian*, Russian*, Turkish*, Ukrainian*
*languages with full audio support
